title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film Opens in Taiwan on November 20
content: Taiwanese film distributor Cai Chang Asia began streaming a Chinese-subtitled trailer for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga on Monday. The trailer reveals that the film will open in Taiwan on November 20.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan: The Final Season Anime's Hindi Dub Streams on Muse India YouTube Channel
content: The channel also began streaming the Asteroid in Love television anime as a daily upload on the same day. The Attack on Titan The Final Season anime premiered on NHK in December 2020 and aired for 16 episodes.

title: Look Back Anime Film Wins Kineko Int'l Film Fest's Teens Feature Award
content: The anime film of Chainsaw Man creator Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga won the Kineko Grand Prix Teens Feature award at the Kineko International Film Festival in Tokyo on Tuesday.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Changed The Mecha Anime Game With This Look
content: The removal of the face vents from the Gundam suits in Mobile Suit Gundam 00 changed the whole aura of the mechs. The face vents gave the robots a human element, as they looked similar to a mouth. The mouth made the machines look much less menacing.
